# BuildWorkPro

> BuildWorkPro is construction project management software built specifically for trade subcontractors — electrical, plumbing, HVAC, roofing, concrete, framing, glazing, and other specialty contractors. One flat price ($79/month or $790/year), unlimited users and projects, all features included, 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

BuildWorkPro covers the full subcontractor workflow: bidding and estimating with line items, labor rates, and markup; AIA-style pay applications with schedule of values; change orders with approval workflows; built-in legally-binding e-signatures for bids and change orders; project management with phases, tasks, and Gantt charts; daily site logs; time tracking; a sales pipeline and CRM; QuickBooks Online sync; document management; and reporting. It connects to AI agents — Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Grok Bot, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent — via MCP, so bids, leads, change orders and pay apps can be built through natural-language conversation and reviewed in the app. It is web-based and works on phones, tablets, and desktops.

Unlike platforms built for general contractors (Procore) or residential home builders (Buildertrend), BuildWorkPro is priced and designed for specialty subcontractors: flat pricing instead of construction-volume quotes, self-serve signup instead of sales demos, and workflows centered on sub-to-GC billing rather than owner-facing portals.

## Product

- [Features overview](https://buildworkpro.com/features/): All modules at a glance
- [AI agents](https://buildworkpro.com/agents/): Run BuildWorkPro from Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Grok Bot, OpenClaw, or Hermes Agent (via MCP) — the agent builds bids, works the inbox into the CRM, drafts change orders; you review and send
- [Bidding & estimating](https://buildworkpro.com/features/construction-bidding/): Line-item bids, labor rates, markup, PDF proposals, bid-to-project conversion
- [Pay applications](https://buildworkpro.com/features/pay-applications/): AIA-style progress billing with schedule of values, retainage, and approval workflow
- [Change orders](https://buildworkpro.com/features/change-orders/): Scoped and priced change orders with approval tracking
- [Project management](https://buildworkpro.com/features/project-management/): Phases, tasks, dependencies, Gantt charts
- [Site logs](https://buildworkpro.com/features/site-logs/): Daily reports with personnel, work performed, materials, issues, and photos
- [Time tracking](https://buildworkpro.com/features/time-tracking/): Crew hours by project and cost code
- [Construction CRM](https://buildworkpro.com/features/construction-crm/): Leads, pipeline stages, contacts
- [Reports](https://buildworkpro.com/features/reports/): Win rates, billing status, project profitability

## Pricing

- [Pricing page](https://buildworkpro.com/pricing/)
- $79/month or $790/year (two months free on annual billing)
- Unlimited users, unlimited projects, all features included — no per-user fees, no tiers, no add-on modules
- 14-day free trial, no credit card required, cancel anytime

## Free templates

- [Templates hub](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/): 42 free construction templates for subcontractors and trade contractors as fillable PDF, Excel and Word, each with a completed example — no email required
- [Pay application template (G702/G703 style)](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/aia-g702-g703/): application and certificate for payment + continuation sheet with retainage math and carry-forward (Excel, fillable PDF)
- [Schedule of values template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/schedule-of-values/): SOV with % of contract math, tie-out check and a billing tracker (Excel, PDF)
- [Contractor invoice template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/construction-invoice/): line items, tax, retainage and balance due (Excel, Word, fillable PDF)
- [Lien waiver forms](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/lien-waiver/): conditional and unconditional waivers for progress and final payment (Word, fillable PDF)
- [Conditional lien waiver form](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/conditional-lien-waiver/): conditional waiver and release on progress and final payment (Word, fillable PDF)
- [Unconditional lien waiver form](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/unconditional-lien-waiver/): unconditional waiver and release on progress and final payment (Word, fillable PDF)
- [Notice to owner (Florida)](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/notice-to-owner/): Florida preliminary notice under Fla. Stat. § 713.06 with the statutory warnings (Word, fillable PDF)
- [Construction estimate template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/construction-estimate/): material/labor/equipment/sub sections with overhead and true-margin pricing (Excel, PDF)
- [Construction bid proposal template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/construction-bid-proposal/): scope, price with alternates, inclusions/exclusions, terms, acceptance block (Word, PDF)
- [Construction quote template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/construction-quote/): one-page fixed-price quote with options and acceptance (Excel, Word, PDF)
- [Bid tabulation template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/bid-tabulation/): level sub and supplier bids side by side (Excel, PDF)
- [Subcontractor agreement template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/subcontractor-agreement/): 15-section standard-form subcontract (Word, PDF)
- [Construction contract template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/construction-contract/): owner–contractor agreement for direct work (Word, PDF)
- [Scope of work template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/scope-of-work/): included work, exclusions, assumptions, by others, acceptance (Word, PDF)
- [Change order template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/change-order/): line-item pricing, contract-sum ladder, time extension, dual signatures, plus a change order log (fillable PDF, Word, Excel)
- [Notice to proceed template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/notice-to-proceed/): start authorization with the contract time clock (Word, fillable PDF)
- [Notice of commencement (Florida)](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/notice-of-commencement/): the recorded Florida form under Fla. Stat. § 713.13 (Word, fillable PDF)
- [Equipment rental agreement](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/equipment-rental-agreement/): bare or operated equipment rental with an equipment schedule, rates, damage and insurance terms (Word, PDF)
- [Construction letter of intent](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/letter-of-intent/): GC-to-subcontractor award letter pending the formal subcontract, with a capped early-work authorization (Word, fillable PDF)
- [Certificate of substantial completion template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/certificate-of-completion/): completion date, punch list, warranty start, retainage release (Word, fillable PDF)
- [Construction daily report template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/daily-report/): crew, weather, work performed, deliveries, delays, safety, photos (fillable PDF, Word, Excel)
- [Work order template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/work-order/): requested work, labor and materials, completion sign-off, with a work order log (fillable PDF, Word, Excel)
- [T&M ticket template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/tm-ticket/): time and materials ticket with ST/OT labor, materials, equipment, same-day signature (fillable PDF, Excel)
- [RFI template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/rfi/): one-question request for information with impact flags, response block and an RFI log (fillable PDF, Word, Excel)
- [Construction timesheet template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/timesheet/): weekly time card by job and cost code with regular/overtime totals (Excel, PDF)
- [Construction schedule template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/construction-schedule/): tasks by phase with durations, predecessors and a formula-driven Gantt (Excel, PDF)
- [Punch list template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/punch-list/): item, location, trade, priority, status, verification with live counts (Excel, Word, PDF)
- [Submittal log template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/submittal-log/): submittal register with status, dates and lead times, plus a transmittal cover sheet (Excel, PDF)
- [Construction budget template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/construction-budget/): budget vs. committed vs. actual by cost code with variance and cost-to-complete (Excel, PDF)
- [Construction meeting minutes template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/meeting-minutes/): attendees, agenda, decisions and action items (Word, fillable PDF)
- [Job safety analysis (JSA) template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/job-safety-analysis/): task steps, hazards, controls, PPE and crew sign-off (fillable PDF, Word, Excel)
- [Toolbox talk template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/toolbox-talk/): safety meeting record with a crew sign-in sheet (fillable PDF, Word)
- [Roofing estimate template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/roofing-estimate/): customer-ready re-roof estimate by phase with a decking allowance; takeoff for squares, pitch factor, bundles, flashing and dumpster tonnage (Excel, Word, fillable PDF)
- [HVAC estimate template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/hvac-estimate/): customer-ready equipment replacement estimate; takeoff for duct runs, line-set length and added refrigerant charge, sized from a load calculation (Excel, Word, fillable PDF)
- [Electrical estimate template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/electrical-estimate/): customer-ready service upgrade and branch-circuit estimate; device-count takeoff to labor hours, wire footage, boxes and breakers (Excel, Word, fillable PDF)
- [Plumbing estimate template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/plumbing-estimate/): customer-ready rough-in, fixtures and water heater estimate; fixture takeoff to rough and trim hours and pipe footage (Excel, Word, fillable PDF)
- [Concrete estimate template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/concrete-estimate/): customer-ready flatwork estimate; slab takeoff for cubic yards, base tons, rebar, forms and control joints (Excel, Word, fillable PDF)
- [Drywall estimate template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/drywall-estimate/): customer-ready hang, tape and finish estimate; takeoff for board count by sheet size, mud, tape and corner bead (Excel, Word, fillable PDF)
- [Painting estimate template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/painting-estimate/): customer-ready interior repaint estimate; takeoff from room dimensions to paintable area, gallons by color and labor hours (Excel, Word, fillable PDF)
- [Flooring estimate template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/flooring-estimate/): customer-ready removal, prep and install estimate; takeoff for square footage with waste, boxes, underlayment and trim (Excel, Word, fillable PDF)
- [Fence estimate template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/fence-estimate/): customer-ready fence estimate; takeoff for posts, rails, pickets, gate hardware and concrete bags per hole (Excel, Word, fillable PDF)
- [Landscaping estimate template](https://buildworkpro.com/templates/landscaping-estimate/): customer-ready yard renovation estimate; takeoff for sod pallets, mulch and soil yards, plants and irrigation (Excel, Word, fillable PDF)
